A `for_each` resource exposes two magic variables inside its block: `each.key` (the map key) and `each.value` (the map value). Set `for_each = local.services` and build `filename` and `content` from those two — no loops, no `count.index`.

The `filename` must be `"${path.module}/output/${each.key}.txt"` — the `path.module` prefix keeps it relative to the module directory, and `each.key` gives you the per-service name. `content` needs both `each.key` and `each.value` to pass the line-by-line check.

The verifier checks the literal strings `Service: auth-service` and `Description: Handles authentication and token issuance` inside `output/auth-service.txt`. Your content template must interpolate exactly: `"Service: ${each.key}\nDescription: ${each.value}\n"`.
